title: Murmuring Mosaic Octopus
statement: A palm-sized octopus with softly glowing freckles spends its days sorting sea glass into ever-changing mosaics on the floor of a dim, kelp-dappled tank, letting out tiny strings of bubbles that sound like a thoughtful "hmm." When a visitor lingers at the glass, it pauses, tilts its head, and nudges one shining pebble toward them, as if offering the first word of a conversation.
